title: Five Action Movies to Stream Now
summary: A quick guide to five high-energy action films currently available to stream, with short synopses and reasons each stands out. Covers modern thrillers and blockbuster-style action to suit a variety of moods and viewing preferences.
content:
Looking for a high-octane movie night? Here are five action films worth streaming now, each offering a different flavor of thrills from visceral hand-to-hand combat to large-scale set pieces.

Extraction (Netflix)
Extraction is a relentless, effects-driven thriller that follows a black-market mercenary tasked with rescuing an abducted child. The film stands out for its extended action set pieces and practical-feeling combat choreography. Ideal for viewers who want nonstop intensity and kinetic camerawork.

John Wick (various platforms)
Keanu Reeves revitalized modern action cinema with John Wick, a tightly choreographed revenge story anchored by a simple premise and expert stunt work. The film blends stylish world-building with brutal, balletic fights and remains essential viewing for fans of precision action and stunt-driven storytelling.

Mad Max: Fury Road (streaming availability varies)
A visual and auditory assault in the best way, Mad Max: Fury Road combines epic chase sequences with striking production design and practical effects. The film is both a blockbuster spectacle and an inventive, character-driven ride, rewarding viewers who appreciate large-scale action grounded in physical filmmaking.

Nobody (Prime Video and others)
Nobody recasts an ordinary man as a surprise action force. Balancing dark humor with visceral fights, the movie delivers satisfying escalation from domestic drama to full-blown action set pieces. Fans of grounded, gritty close-quarters combat and surprising character turns will enjoy this pick.

The Raid (availability varies)
A modern classic of martial arts cinema, The Raid is famed for its incredibly intense hand-to-hand combat and tight, claustrophobic pacing. The film places viewers in the middle of a single building raid, escalating tension through masterful choreography and relentless momentum.

Tips for streaming
Availability can change by region and over time, so check your local streaming services or rental platforms. If you prefer physical effects and choreography, prioritize Mad Max, John Wick, and The Raid. For high-intensity modern thrillers, Extraction and Nobody are strong choices. Consider viewing with headphones for the best sound design experience on films like Fury Road.

Final thoughts
Whether you want grounded fight choreography, stylish world-building, or large-scale vehicular mayhem, this list offers a varied sampling of action cinema. Each title delivers distinct thrills, making them solid options for a movie night focused on adrenaline and spectacle.
